facts.value: A body of Christians commonly called Quakers, prominent in the colonization of New Jersey and Pennsylvania. American Friends divided in 1827-1828 after the teaching of Elias Hicks.

citations.excerpt: In American history they occupy an important place because of the very prominent part which they played in the colonization of New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
